Protein Food

Pork Neck

About This Entry

Pork neck (collar) is a flavorful, well-marbled cut popular in European and Asian cooking. Richer than loin, it suits medium reds and whites with body when roasted or braised.

Beginner Guide

Pork neck is undervalued in US retail but common in Italian and Thai markets. Benefits from slow cooking or marinating.

FAQ

What is Pork Neck?
Pork neck is undervalued in US retail but common in Italian and Thai markets.
How should Pork Neck be cooked?
Cook to safe internal temperature; richer cuts tolerate slow cooking, smoke, and braising that build pairing-friendly flavor.
